verdict.rationale: Mistral Document AI does not ship RAG chunking, but it gives you the building blocks. The `include_blocks` option returns per-page arrays of paragraph-level blocks with structural labels, bounding boxes and reading order, which approximates semantic boundaries with metadata. Headers and footers are split into separate fields, and confidence scores are available per block. Missing for 10: purpose-built RAG chunking (size/token control, overlap), embedding-ready segments or a direct embedding integration, chunk-level metadata such as section hierarchy, and independent hands-on corroboration of block output for RAG use.
